# excalidraw-skill-pack
> Editable Excalidraw diagrams for AI agents: methodology, 29 types with fixtures, taste gate, themes, MCP.

## Docs
- https://excalidraw-skill-pack.vercel.app/
- https://excalidraw-skill-pack.vercel.app/gallery/
- https://excalidraw-skill-pack.vercel.app/vs-diagram-design/
- https://excalidraw-skill-pack.vercel.app/vs-official-excalidraw-mcp/
- https://excalidraw-skill-pack.vercel.app/themes/
- https://github.com/isatimur/excalidraw-skill-pack

## Types (29)
Architecture, flowchart, sequence, state, ER, timeline, Gantt, swimlane, quadrant, loop, process, layers, nested, medallion, tree, org-chart, venn, pyramid, evidence, comparison, high-level, it-state, data-flow, dp-integration, dp-security-matrix, bar, line, scatter, radar. Each has editable .excalidraw + PNG at /gallery/

## vs diagram-design
Editable Excalidraw + themes + MCP vs static HTML+SVG: https://excalidraw-skill-pack.vercel.app/vs-diagram-design/

## Install
npx @excalidraw-skill-pack/install claude-code

## Try first (no install)
Telegram or WhatsApp demo: https://app.clawmama.run/skills/s8dq2k/hermes
